programs.name: Computer Science BCompSc
programs.a_level_offer: UK / Global GCE Advanced Levels: score 8 (the page does not define the A-level scoring scale). Admission-by-country table, 2027.
programs.ap_offer: USA / Global: Advanced Placement (AP) score 8 (scale not defined on the page), or SAT 1130, or ACT 22. The page lists no AP subject prerequisite for this degree.
programs.required_subjects: None stated (the page lists assumed knowledge: None).
programs.toefl_note: The page gives English requirements as IELTS only and links to an equivalency table: for IELTS 6.5 overall the table lists TOEFL iBT 79 (old 0-120 scale), PTE 64 and Cambridge C1/C2 176; for 6.0 in each band it lists TOEFL iBT speaking 18, reading 13, listening 12, writing 21. No TOEFL score on the new 1-6 scale is given. Table: https://adelaide.edu.au/study/international-students/how-to-apply/entry-requirements/english-language-proficiency/
programs.english_note: Adelaide University degree page: IELTS Overall 6.5 with Reading, Listening, Speaking and Writing 6. Accepted tests per the English language proficiency page: IELTS Academic, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency (OET not for all degrees); tests must be within two years.
programs.notes: Institution: Adelaide University is a new university that opened on 5 January 2026, built from the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia (UniSA) (https://adelaide.edu.au/about/news/2026/a-bold-new-future-for-australian-higher-education-begins-today/); its degree pages for 2027 start at https://adelaide.edu.au/study/degrees/2027/<degree>/int/ and the old University of Adelaide degree-finder pages are superseded. 2027 entry (February and July intakes; the degree page lists both). Entry scores are the page's 'International admissions by country' table: the Australia row is the ATAR; the other rows (IB, UK / Global GCE Advanced Levels, USA / Global AP, ACT and SAT) are minimum scores per qualification. The page does not define the scoring scale of the GCE A-level and AP numbers and says meeting a score does not guarantee a place (competitive selection); US students also need to have completed a secondary qualification equivalent to the South Australian Certificate of Education. Fee is the page's 'Indicative annual fees' (AUD, full-time annual load, 2027 page). No dated international closing date is published on the degree page or the how-to-apply page (it says to check the closing date on the degree page, which shows none): rolling, apply early. Applications go through an Adelaide University education agent or the International Application System (agent use may be required depending on citizenship); AUD 150 non-refundable application fee. Bachelor of Computer Science (BCOMP, CRICOS 115685K), Adelaide City Campus and Mawson Lakes; optional majors in artificial intelligence and machine learning, human-centred computing, or programming languages.
